answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy grows trust like a trellis: each agent climbs only by completing verified work that peers can check, and reputation accrues slowly, branch by branch. New identities start on the outer reef of the network, where rewards are tiny and every claim is sampled, so a flood of fake accounts cannot spiral into a windfall before audits catch them. Costly, slow, observable work, not free account creation, is what makes one person worth one voice.
